verdict.rationale: OpenClaw ships ClawHub, a documented public skills/plugins registry with a native CLI (`openclaw skills search/install/update/verify/list/info`) letting users discover and install a capability in one command, plus install-from-Git/local-directory support (openclaw-docs-30, -55, -72, -82, -94). A community report (openclaw-comm-2) that a malicious skill topped the registry doesn't contradict the install mechanism itself but is a real caveat about registry curation/safety. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the one-click experience and evidence of vetting/moderation quality in the registry.
